accumulated_depreciation.description: An asset bought before the books start: its opening accumulated depreciation, only while none of its depreciation has posted.

cost.description: An asset bought before the books start: its cost, only while none of its depreciation has posted.

life_months.description: A new useful life in months, from its start: it applies to the months not posted yet, and ends in or after the first of them.

purchased_on.description: An asset bought before the books start: its purchase date, only while none of its depreciation has posted.

residual.description: A new residual value: it applies to the months not posted yet.

start.description: A new start month: only while none of its depreciation has posted.
